Replaces the Tablet's old cost discount. On each combat's first turn, if the first two manual cards are Attacks, Skills, or Powers of different types, draw 2 after the second resolves. Matching types, other types, or fewer than two grant nothing. Autoplay does not count; once per combat. The report covers only the sampled area and grants no immunity to bias.
Replaces the Tablet's old cost discount. On each combat's second turn, if the first two manual cards are Attacks, Skills, or Powers of different types, draw 3 after the second resolves. Matching types, other types, or fewer than two grant nothing. Autoplay does not count; once per combat. An ambient-temperature, poor-ore control is recorded; generalization remains deferred.
ARISTOTLE_CATEGORY_TABLET.bacon.unavaila: Bacon's record is unavailable. The new draw practice is inactive and grants no retroactive benefit. No samples are rewritten and no plan is chosen automatically.
PLATO_CIVIC_SEAL.luther.title: Care for a Neighbor
PLATO_CIVIC_SEAL.luther.description: You helped your companion and switched to Luther's Self and Other. Augustine's first-turn 6 Block or 1 Energy no longer applies. The Civic Seal's base practice remains. Help purchases no salvation and adds no religious score or combat reward.
ROUSSEAU_UNCARVED_STONE.machiavelli.bank: Replaces convention discounts and their enemy Strength cost. Each combat, if your first manual card on turn 1 is a Skill, gain 8 Block at the start of turn 2. A different first card forfeits the benefit. Automatic cards do not count. Counter: 2 waiting, 1 prepared, 0 spent or missed.
ROUSSEAU_UNCARVED_STONE.machiavelli.coor: Replaces convention discounts and their enemy Strength cost. Each combat, if your first manual card on turn 1 is an Attack, gain 2 Energy at the start of turn 2. A different first card forfeits the benefit. Automatic cards do not count. Counter: 2 waiting, 1 prepared, 0 spent or missed.
ROUSSEAU_UNCARVED_STONE.machiavelli.unav: This combat’s preparation cannot be confirmed. Its benefit is suspended.
ARISTOTLE_CATEGORY_TABLET.ockham.title: Verified list
ARISTOTLE_CATEGORY_TABLET.ockham.descrip: Replaces the tablet’s printed cost-category rule. Each turn, the first manual non-X Attack, Skill or Power names a card model. The next 2 manually played non-X cards of that model cost 2 less (minimum 0). A zero-cost first card gives no discount this turn. Other names do not qualify.
HERACLITUS_LYRE.title: Lyre and Bow
HERACLITUS_LYRE.description: Each turn, the first non-Exhaust Attack or Skill drawn at turn start has Retain this turn. If you have manually played the opposite type this turn, manually playing the marked card Exhausts it and draws 1 card. Otherwise, it resolves normally.
HERACLITUS_LYRE.tension.title: Tension of the Lyre
HERACLITUS_LYRE.tension.waiting: No card marked yet this turn. The first non-Exhaust Attack or Skill drawn at turn start will be marked.
HERACLITUS_LYRE.tension.held: Counter 1: the shown card has Retain this turn. Manually play the opposite type to reach 2. Playing it directly resolves normally.
HERACLITUS_LYRE.tension.ready: Counter 2: manually playing the shown card Exhausts it and draws 1 card. You may keep it instead; its mark ends next turn.
HERACLITUS_LYRE.tension.spent: This turn's marking opportunity has ended. A new one begins next turn.
SOCRATES_QUESTION_CUP.title: Question Cup
SOCRATES_QUESTION_CUP.description: On the first turn of each combat, you may put up to 2 cards from your hand on the bottom of your draw pile, then draw that many.
SOCRATES_QUESTION_CUP.selection_prompt: Choose up to 2 cards to put on the bottom of your draw pile.
SOCRATES_QUESTION_CUP.flavor: The cup leaves room for an unanswered question.
SOCRATES_BALANCE_WEIGHT.title: Reflective Weight
SOCRATES_BALANCE_WEIGHT.description: On the first turn of each combat, you may choose 1 Attack or Skill. At each turn's end, Retain it and reduce its cost by 1 while it remains in hand. It Exhausts when played manually.
SOCRATES_BALANCE_WEIGHT.plotinus.title: Plotinus: distinct forms
SOCRATES_BALANCE_WEIGHT.plotinus.descrip: On the Plotinus route, play exactly Skill, Attack, Skill manually in one turn, using two different Skill models. At turn end, gain 5 Block.
SOCRATES_BALANCE_WEIGHT.selection_prompt: Choose up to 1 Attack or Skill to retain, or choose none and use your hand as it is.
SOCRATES_BALANCE_WEIGHT.flavor: The balance calls for repeated adjustment.
PLATO_CIVIC_SEAL.title: Civic Seal
PLATO_CIVIC_SEAL.description: The first Attack or Skill played manually each combat establishes its type as law. Each turn, the first matching card costs 1 less and the first opposing card costs 1 more.
PLATO_CIVIC_SEAL.flavor: Distinct duties leave a common imprint.
PLATO_CIVIC_SEAL.augustine.public.title: Public Repair
PLATO_CIVIC_SEAL.augustine.public.descri: You assigned the crew to the public gate. On your first turn of each later combat, gain 6 Block. Your original Civic Seal practice remains.
PLATO_CIVIC_SEAL.augustine.private.title: Companions' Repair
PLATO_CIVIC_SEAL.augustine.private.descr: You assigned the crew to the companions' cart. On your first turn of each later combat, gain 1 Energy. Your original Civic Seal practice remains.
DESCARTES_THINKING_LENS.title: Meditation Lens
DESCARTES_THINKING_LENS.response.title: Response Window
DESCARTES_THINKING_LENS.response.unbound: No living enemy is bound, or the old target is unavailable. A first manual single-target Attack can bind one.
DESCARTES_THINKING_LENS.response.waiting: An enemy is bound. Starting next turn, its intent grants one response discount.
DESCARTES_THINKING_LENS.response.skill: The bound enemy intends to Attack. Your first positive-cost Skill this turn costs 1 less.
DESCARTES_THINKING_LENS.response.target: The bound enemy does not intend to Attack. Your first positive-cost single-target Attack against it costs 1 less. With multiple enemies, choose a target first.
DESCARTES_THINKING_LENS.response.spent: The response discount has been used this turn. The bound intent is checked again next turn.
DESCARTES_THINKING_LENS.description: After you first manually Attack an enemy, starting next turn: if it intends to Attack, your first Skill costs 1 less; otherwise, your first Attack targeting it costs 1 less.
DESCARTES_THINKING_LENS.flavor: Before seeing, ask who is looking.
ARISTOTLE_CATEGORY_TABLET.title: Category Tablet
ARISTOTLE_CATEGORY_TABLET.description: Each turn, the first manually played non-X Attack, Skill, or Power establishes its current cost category: 0, 1, or 2+. The next 2 cards in that category cost 1 less.
ARISTOTLE_CATEGORY_TABLET.flavor: Names give differences a place in discussion.
ROUSSEAU_UNCARVED_STONE.title: Uncarved Stone
ROUSSEAU_UNCARVED_STONE.description: At turn end, the unique most manually played card becomes convention if played twice or more; otherwise keep the old convention. Starting next turn, your first positive-cost convention card each turn costs 1 less, then ALL enemies gain 1 Strength.
ROUSSEAU_UNCARVED_STONE.convention.title: Current Convention
ROUSSEAU_UNCARVED_STONE.convention.unfor: No convention yet. At turn end, a unique most manually played card type played at least twice becomes convention.
ROUSSEAU_UNCARVED_STONE.convention.ready: The card type shown below is convention; upgraded and ordinary copies count together. Each turn, the first positive-cost copy costs 1 less, then all living enemies gain 1 Strength. Free cards do not consume this opportunity.
ROUSSEAU_UNCARVED_STONE.convention.spent: This turn's convention discount is spent. The card type persists until replaced; its once-per-turn opportunity returns next turn.
ROUSSEAU_UNCARVED_STONE.flavor: Leaving something untouched can be a choice.
KONGZI_MUDUO.title: Muduo
KONGZI_MUDUO.description: Each turn, after playing a Skill or Power before an Attack, Skills grant temporary Strength, up to 5. If you Attack first, lose 1 Strength this turn and Skills grant no Strength.
KONGZI_MUDUO.flavor: A wooden-tongued bell used to carry an ordered proclamation.
KONGZI_QING_YU_PEI.title: Green Jade Pendant
KONGZI_QING_YU_PEI.description: Once per combat. When no enemy intends to Attack, if you could play an Attack this turn but play none, gain 1 Virtue and add 1 distinct Uncommon or Rare card to the card reward. Attacking first disables this relic for the combat.
KONGZI_QING_YU_PEI.flavor: The noble compare virtue to jade: gentle, lustrous, and enduring.
MENGZI_XIONG_ZHANG.title: Bear Paw
MENGZI_XIONG_ZHANG.description: For the first N turns of each combat, gain 1 Energy and draw 2 additional cards. N equals its inherited Virtue.
MENGZI_XIONG_ZHANG.flavor: I desire fish, and I also desire bear's paw.
XUNZI_SHENG_MO.title: Ink Line
XUNZI_SHENG_MO.description: The first time each turn you consecutively play a Skill, an Attack, and a Skill, gain 1 Strength and 1 Dexterity.
XUNZI_SHENG_MO.flavor: Wood becomes straight by the ink line; metal becomes sharp on the whetstone.
MOZI_MO_SE_ZHU_JIAN.title: Ink Bamboo Slips
MOZI_MO_SE_ZHU_JIAN.description: At the start of your turn, ALL characters gain 6 Block. If no character lost HP last turn, gain 1 Mutual Benefit, up to 2. Gain 1 Energy and draw 1 additional card per Mutual Benefit. When any character loses HP, lose all Mutual Benefit.
MOZI_MO_SE_ZHU_JIAN.flavor: Care for one another; benefit one another.
MOZI_SHOU_CHENG_TU.title: City Defense Diagram
MOZI_SHOU_CHENG_TU.description: If an enemy intends to Attack and you take no direct damage from enemies, gain 6 Block at the start of your next turn.
MOZI_SHOU_CHENG_TU.flavor: To stop aggression, first make the defense unbroken.
LAOZI_WU_WEI_SHU_JIAN.title: Wu Wei Slips
LAOZI_WU_WEI_SHU_JIAN.description: At the end of your turn, if you played no more than 2 cards this turn, Retain your hand. Next turn, gain 2 Energy and 2 Dexterity.
LAOZI_WU_WEI_SHU_JIAN.flavor: Act without contrivance, and nothing remains undone.
LAOZI_SHUI_YU.title: Water Jade
LAOZI_SHUI_YU.description: At the end of your turn, if you have unspent Energy, take 50% less Attack damage until your next turn.
LAOZI_SHUI_YU.flavor: Nothing is softer than water, yet nothing surpasses it in overcoming the hard.
QIN_GULI_SHOU_CHENG_XIE.title: City Defense Machinery
QIN_GULI_SHOU_CHENG_XIE.description: At the start of your turn, gain 4 Block for each enemy that intends to Attack, up to 12. If you take no direct damage from enemies before your next turn, apply 1 Weak to ALL enemies.
QIN_GULI_SHOU_CHENG_XIE.flavor: A small state may await a great assault when every defense is prepared.
ZHUANGZI_DA_HU.title: Great Gourd
ZHUANGZI_DA_HU.description: At the end of your turn, if you played no more than 2 cards, Retain your hand. The first 2 cards played next turn cost 1 less and grant 4 Block each.
ZHUANGZI_DA_HU.flavor: Why not make it a great vessel and float through the rivers and lakes?
YANGZHU_QUAN_SHENG_BI.title: Whole Life Bi
YANGZHU_QUAN_SHENG_BI.description: At the end of your turn, preserve up to 2 unspent Energy. Take 50% less Attack damage until your next turn, then regain the preserved Energy.
YANGZHU_QUAN_SHENG_BI.flavor: Keep one's nature whole and true, unburdened by external things.
HUISHI_LI_WU_CHOU.title: Enumeration Counters
HUISHI_LI_WU_CHOU.description: At the start of your turn, you and ALL enemies gain 8 Block. The first time each turn you break an enemy's Block, gain 1 Energy, draw 1 card, and deal 8 damage to ALL enemies.
HUISHI_LI_WU_CHOU.flavor: Extend care to all things; Heaven and Earth are one body.
ANAXIMENES_BREATH.title: Breath in Motion
ANAXIMENES_BREATH.description: At turn end, if you have at least 1 unspent Energy, gain 1 Energy and draw 1 card next turn.
SOCRATES_QUESTION_CUP.anselm.published.d: Your recorded reply grants 1 Energy on the first turn of each later combat.
SOCRATES_QUESTION_CUP.anselm.revised.des: Your revised draft grants 6 Block on the first turn of each later combat.
SOCRATES_QUESTION_CUP.anselm.withdrawn.d: Your withdrawal grants 8 Block on the second turn of each later combat.
PLATO_CIVIC_SEAL.aquinas.published.title: Published Revision
PLATO_CIVIC_SEAL.aquinas.published.descr: If your first manually played card each combat is a Skill, gain 5 Block after it resolves. Another card type spends the chance.
PLATO_CIVIC_SEAL.aquinas.emergency.title: Narrow Exception
PLATO_CIVIC_SEAL.aquinas.emergency.descr: If your first manually played card each combat is an Attack, gain 1 Energy after it resolves. Another card type spends the chance.
PLATO_CIVIC_SEAL.zeno.public.title: A Public Rule
PLATO_CIVIC_SEAL.zeno.public.description: After the first manual card each turn that follows an established rule, gain 3 Block. The card establishing the rule does not count; existing cost rules remain.
PLATO_CIVIC_SEAL.zeno.conditional.title: An Appealable Exception
PLATO_CIVIC_SEAL.zeno.conditional.descri: After the first manual card each turn of the other type, draw 1 card. The card establishing the rule does not count; its existing cost increase remains.
PLATO_CIVIC_SEAL.zeno.unavailable.title: Seal Improvement Unconfirmed
PLATO_CIVIC_SEAL.zeno.unavailable.descri: The saved improvement could not be confirmed. Its record is preserved and its effect is inactive; existing cost rules remain.
HERACLITUS_LYRE.galileo.title: Repeat Under the Same Conditions
HERACLITUS_LYRE.galileo.description: The lyre’s change is saved. Its original draw 1 per release is replaced by one draw 3 per combat: match the model and actual positive Energy spent by the combat’s first manually played non-X Attack or Skill, then complete a marked release into Exhaust on a later turn. Marking, Retain and the opposing-type preparation still apply.
HERACLITUS_LYRE.galileo.unavailable: The measurement payload cannot be verified. Repeated-measurement draws are suspended; the original release draw is not restored.
HERACLITUS_LYRE.galileo.sample.title: This Combat’s Reference Sample
HERACLITUS_LYRE.galileo.sample.pending: The reference card below actually spent {Energy} Energy on turn {Turn}. On a later turn, release a marked card of that model with the same payment into Exhaust to draw 3, once this combat.
HERACLITUS_LYRE.galileo.sample.claimed: The sample spent {Energy} Energy on turn {Turn}. This combat’s draw 3 has been claimed. The original release draw 1 does not return.
SOCRATES_QUESTION_CUP.newton.drop.title: Question Cup: Falling Calibration
SOCRATES_QUESTION_CUP.newton.drop.descri: Keep all existing Question Cup effects. Calibrated falling cargo: at the end of your turn, if you manually played exactly two cards this turn, Attack then Skill, gain 6 Block, at most once per turn; automatically played cards do not count, and a third manual card invalidates the effect.
SOCRATES_QUESTION_CUP.newton.tide.title: Question Cup: Tidal Calibration
SOCRATES_QUESTION_CUP.newton.tide.descri: Keep all existing Question Cup effects. Calibrated tidal transport: at the end of your turn, if you manually played exactly two cards this turn, Skill then Attack, gain 6 Block, at most once per turn; automatically played cards do not count, and a third manual card invalidates the effect.
DESCARTES_THINKING_LENS.spinoza.interven: The Meditation Lens keeps its original effects. In each combat, after the first manual single-target Attack resolves, apply 1 Weak to the same still-living enemy; if that target is already dead, the chance is spent, with no retargeting and no later grant. Automatic plays are excluded.
DESCARTES_THINKING_LENS.spinoza.reordere: The Meditation Lens keeps its original effects. In each combat, after the first manual Skill resolves, draw 1, provided there was no manual Attack before it; if there was already a manual Attack, the chance is spent and no card is drawn. Automatic plays are excluded.
